# template_example_item (Resource)

Manages an example item in Terraform state. Replace this with a real API-backed resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "template_example_item" "example" {
  name        = "example"
  description = "Created by the provider template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Example item name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Example item description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier derived from the item name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import template_example_item.example example-item-example
```
